subject: Infra hiring slate: runtime & platform roles — approval request
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Elise Park <elise.park@talentops.io>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Infra hiring slate: runtime & platform roles — approval request

Hi Marissa / Markus —

We'd like to request approval to open three headcount slots on the infra/platform side for Q1 hiring. This is the consolidated packet from the runtime team after the product backlog reprioritization: two IC4/IC5 software engineers (runtime inference optimizations), and one Production SRE (platform). High-level rationale below and attached packet + comp bands.

Summary of asks:
- 1x Senior SWE, Runtime (IC5) — focus: kernel selection, batching, KV cache optimizations
- 1x SWE, Runtime (IC4) — focus: quantization tooling and model integration
- 1x Production SRE (IC4/IC5 flexible) — focus: observability, autoscaling policies for Dedicated pools

Why now: the Dedicated product demand is up 3x M/M in targeted customers; we need infra capacity and a few execution-side features (batching policies, KV cache snapshotting) to hit SLA commitments. Risk if we delay: longer lead time to productionize optimizations, higher token cost trends.

Comp bands: see 2026_comp_bands_infra.xlsx — we've aligned suggested bands to market comps and internal leveling (IC4: 170-200k base, IC5: 220-260k base, with equity ranges noted). Total comp impact for FY27 (if hired in Q1) estimated ~ $1.2M fully loaded for all three. Budget owner: Platform budget (Marissa).

Attachments: hc_request_packet_2026.pdf (role descriptions, hiring timeline, ramp assumptions), req_descriptions_runtime_platform.docx (JD drafts).

Requested approvals:
1) Headcount (3 FTE) — yes/no
2) Compensation bands — greenlight to offer within proposed ranges
3) Priority & sequencing — do we hire all at once or stagger?

If you approve, I'll push reqs to Greenhouse and loop TalentOps (Elise) to start candidate sourcing this week.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Infra hiring slate: runtime & platform roles — approval request

Jonas — thanks for the packet, good work pulling the numbers together. I support the hires in principle. A few quick notes: 

- Band guidance: confirm whether IC5 here is comparable to Production SWE IC5 vs Research IC5; we should lock expected scope (ownership + oncall) because comp differs.
- Suggest we stagger: hire the Prod SRE + one Runtime SWE first. That gives us immediate capacity on reliability while the second runtime hire can follow after two months.
- Can TalentOps start with a market map for Bay Area vs Remote candidates? We need to know comp pressure.

Approve headcount: yes (3) pending the comp alignment note above. Approve initial move to post reqs and engage recruiters.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 08:29:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Infra hiring slate: runtime & platform roles — approval request

Thanks — I reviewed the packet. I approve the headcount (3) and the bands as proposed with one caveat: for IC5 offers we should include a stronger equity kicker for retention (given market volatility for infra talent). Work with People Ops on a calibrated equity proposal.

Sequencing: agree with Markus — prioritize the Prod SRE and one Runtime SWE (IC5). That gives us front-line stability for Dedicated while enabling targeted perf wins. If TalentOps can present a Bay Area vs Remote comp delta by EOD Thursday that will help finalize location strategy.

Jonas — please set the req priority to P0 for the SRE and P1 for the first runtime engineer. Post the reqs and tag me on the Greenhouse cards.

Cheers,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Platform & Product
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Elise Park <elise.park@talentops.io>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 14:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Infra hiring slate: runtime & platform roles — approval request

Quick fiscal note: Finance needs the expected hiring quarter and ramp profile to update FY27 headcount plan. Jonas — can you confirm: start quarter Q1 2027 for all three, with a 4-month average ramp to full productivity for SWE and 3 months for SRE? Also confirm whether recruiting is targeted to Bay Area or open remote (affects comp and taxes).

If we proceed, Finance asks to hold $150k in contingency for early equity adjustments if offers need to be competitive. Once Jonas posts reqs, please include the expected headcount billing codes.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Finance Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming approvals and next steps below: 

Approvals:
- Headcount: 3 FTE approved (Marissa)
- Bands: approved with equity note (Marissa)
- Sequencing: P0 Prod SRE, P1 Runtime IC5, follow with Runtime IC4 in ~8 weeks (Markus + Marissa)
- Finance: contingency $150k reserved (Tessa)

Actions I will take this week: 
1) Create 3 reqs in Greenhouse (INF-2026-101, INF-2026-102, INF-2026-103) and set priorities (SRE P0, Runtime IC5 P1, Runtime IC4 P2). I'll tag Marissa on the SRE card and People Ops for equity calibration.
2) Loop TalentOps (Elise) — start market map for Bay Area vs Remote and candidate sourcing.
3) Schedule a short comp calibration meeting Friday 11/6 at 10am PST to finalize offer bands and RSU guidance.
4) Upload final packet and job descriptions to Recruiting Drive (link below).

Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/recruiting/infra-hc-2026
Greenhouse board: https://greenhouse.io/board/Redwood/INF-2026-reqs

Elise / Andrew — please confirm you have the reqs and will prioritize initial outreach to passive candidates in the next 48 hours.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference
